target: acceptance 7 — a clean hardened review is the strongest signal this pipeline produces and is still not a merge signal. The hardened branch must not introduce any merge command.
cmd: s="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/review/SKILL.md"; sec=$(awk "/[Hh]ardened/{on=1} on{print} on&&/^[0-9]+\\. \\*\\*/{n++; if(n>2) exit}" "$s" | tr "\n" " " | tr -s " "); merge=$(printf "%s" "$sec" | grep -ci "gh pr merge\|git merge"); pr=$(grep -ci "terminal state is an OPEN PR\|Nothing merges here" "$s"); printf '{"mergeCmds":%s,"prTerminal":%s}' "$merge" "$pr"
